about.label: About
about.title: Full-stack engineering, from requirements to production support.
about.body: I'm a Software Engineer at Cloudus Infotech, working as a Full Stack Developer on production web applications built with Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, PostgreSQL/Supabase, MongoDB, and AWS. My work spans the entire lifecycle — requirements, database design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

pillars.title: Frontend
pillars.text: Responsive frontend modules and reusable UI components with React.js and Next.js.

pillars.title: Backend & APIs
pillars.text: Backend features, REST APIs, and service integrations with Node.js, NestJS, and Core PHP.

pillars.title: Authentication & security
pillars.text: Secure authentication with JWT and sessions, role-based access, and protected routes.

pillars.title: Databases
pillars.text: Database design and database-driven features on PostgreSQL, Supabase, MySQL, and MongoDB.

pillars.title: Deployment
pillars.text: Deployments on Vercel and AWS, including domain & DNS configuration and SSL.

pillars.title: Production support
pillars.text: Performance optimization, debugging, testing, and production troubleshooting.

trafica.summary: Developed a SaaS-based SEO and GEO analysis platform that evaluates how websites perform across traditional search and AI-powered search engines.
highlights: Implemented automated website scanning covering technical SEO, crawlability, metadata, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and on-page SEO signals.
Built AI visibility analysis to measure how brands appear in AI-generated answers across platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.
Implemented GEO scoring, competitor comparison, citation analysis, and prioritized recommendations to help users identify and resolve search-visibility gaps.
Developed scan history and performance tracking, allowing users to re-run website audits, monitor score improvements, and measure the estimated impact of implemented fixes.

olysim.summary: Developed a global eSIM marketplace enabling travelers to browse, purchase, and manage prepaid mobile data plans by country and region.
highlights: Implemented the complete eSIM purchase journey, including destination and plan selection, Stripe/PayPal payments, eSIM delivery, QR-code installation, activation, and usage tracking.
Built a secure customer account system with OTP verification, Google authentication, Firebase integration, protected routes, and purchase/account management.
Developed customer retention and B2B features, including OlyCoins loyalty rewards, referral discounts, travel content/help center, and a partner-reseller program with API access.

Built a multi-region, multi-domain architecture using Next.js 15 and TypeScript on AWS Amplify, with host-based routing, regional/currency handling, canonical SEO management, UTM tracking, and performance/accessibility optimization.

cloudusExam.summary: Developed a secure online examination platform with automated candidate intake, eligibility management, question-bank administration, exam configuration, and result processing.
highlights: Integrated Google Forms with Google Apps Script and backend APIs to automatically synchronize candidate applications, with additional CSV and manual candidate management.
Built a configurable question-paper generation engine supporting multiple sections, difficulty-based question distribution, randomized questions/options, and immutable exam-paper snapshots.
Implemented a robust exam-taking system with countdown timer, question navigation, autosave, exam-state persistence, resume functionality, and automatic submission.

Developed anti-cheating and assessment workflows, monitoring tab switching, fullscreen exit, copy/paste, print, and other unauthorized activity, with automated violation-based exam termination and detailed scoring/reporting.

braoza.summary: Developed a SaaS platform for monitoring website accessibility, enabling organizations to register and manage multiple websites under their company accounts.
highlights: Implemented automated accessibility scanning and WCAG issue detection, helping identify accessibility problems across registered websites.
Built AI-powered image accessibility features to detect images with missing or inadequate alt text and generate suitable alternative descriptions.
Developed automated accessibility fixes and tracking, allowing users to review and manage remediation actions for individual websites.
Implemented supporting SaaS functionality, including mobile responsiveness monitoring, team management, usage/quota tracking, billing & invoices, account management, and support tickets.

vongo.summary: Developed an online event ticketing platform that enables users to discover and purchase tickets for events, parties, and entertainment activities.
highlights: Implemented event discovery and categorization, allowing users to find events based on categories and locations.
Built an event management and ticket-selling workflow for organizers to create and manage events through the platform.
Integrated a ticket scanning system/mobile scanning app to support ticket validation and event entry management.
Developed a complete digital platform covering event promotion, ticket sales, customer orders, and event-entry operations.

exambro.summary: Developed a multi-exam preparation platform for JEE, NEET, CUET, and multiple state-level CET examinations, supporting chapter-wise and topic-wise practice.
highlights: Implemented NTA-style online mock tests with timed exams, question navigation, subject sections, and detailed result analysis.
Built a large PYQ/question-bank system with multilingual support across English, Hindi, and Gujarati.
Developed a teacher-focused question paper generator with manual, automatic, and expert modes, smart filtering, no-repeat logic, institute branding, and PDF, solution, and PPT generation.
Implemented performance analytics and AI-assisted learning features, including accuracy, time analysis, chapter mastery, question recommendations, solution analysis, and study guidance.

assureit.summary: Developed a cloud-based SaaS platform for coordinating infrastructure projects, permits, applications, and communication between organizations and applicants.
highlights: Implemented workflows for permit and application management, helping organizations process and track infrastructure-related requests.
Built functionality to facilitate communication and coordination between applicants, infrastructure organizations, and relevant stakeholders.
Designed the platform to support multiple industries, including utilities, energy, transportation, telecommunications, municipalities, defense, and environmental services.

federation.summary: Developed an internal data-entry and case management system for managing records related to stolen and recovered property cases.
highlights: Implemented secure user authentication and role-based access for authorized personnel.
Built structured workflows for entering, updating, tracking, and managing stolen-property records.
Designed data management features to help users quickly search and maintain case and property information.
Developed an administrative system focused on accurate record keeping and efficient handling of large volumes of case-related data.

radheshyam.summary: Developed an e-commerce platform for steelware, cookware, crockery, kitchen appliances, storage products, and household essentials.
highlights: Implemented a product catalog and category-based shopping, allowing customers to browse products across cookware, dinnerware, kitchen storage, appliances, gifting, and more.
Built detailed product pages with pricing, discounts, specifications, reviews, product variants, warranty information, and purchase options.
Implemented an online shopping experience with cart/add-to-cart functionality, product discovery, ordering, and delivery support, including international shipping.
Developed a modern, responsive storefront focused on online retail, product presentation, customer reviews, promotional pricing, and a seamless shopping experience.

community.summary: Developed a centralized community management platform for creating and managing multiple Gam/Parivar community applications.
highlights: Implemented community administration workflows, including application creation, editing, activation/deactivation, and status management.
Built member, surname, and family management features for organizing community information in a structured manner.
Implemented custom domain and administrator configuration for individual community applications.
Developed a centralized dashboard with search, filtering, and application management to simplify administration across multiple communities.

villageonweb.summary: A platform that gives villages their own presence on the web, with a public A–Z directory of villages and a dedicated page for each village.

jovasu.tagline: E-commerce store for sweets & dry fruits
jovasu.summary: Developed an online store for Jovasu Dryfruits, Surat — sweets, dry fruits, gift boxes, and daily kitchen staples with pan-India delivery.
highlights: Built category-based shopping across Gifting, Royal Cashews, Sweets & Chocolates, Pistachio Delights, Mixed Dry Fruits, and Indian Sweets, with best-seller, hero-product, and popular-product showcases.
Implemented Watch & Shop video shopping, gifting, and bulk-order sections, along with blogs, FAQs, and store-visit information.
Added customer features including order history, wishlist, cart, and live purchase notifications.
Deployed with Next.js on Vercel, serving product media through Cloudinary.
